title: Nexus Fleet Intelligence
tagline: A trucking co-pilot that cuts bid decisions from minutes to seconds
domain: Agentic AI co-pilot, trucking and logistics
summary: An agentic co-pilot that cuts a small fleet's load-bid decision from about 10 minutes to seconds; recognised as the most market-ready idea at Maven Pitch Day 2025.
brief: Problem: small fleets lose loads on latency, not merit. Managers cross-reference 8+ variables across 2-5 load boards for about 10 minutes per bid.
Call: picked load bidding as the highest-value, underserved agentic AI wedge, and scoped a 3-week MVP around a profit-first ranked view.
Result: bid decision time from about 10 minutes to seconds in the prototype, a $500M+ ARR opportunity sized, and a Pitch Day recognition.
